title: PCPP description for an arbitrary property
statement: Let $n$ be a positive natural number and let $P$ be a property of Boolean strings of length $n$. There is a description of a probabilistically checkable proof system with proof length $2^{2^n}$, query count $3$, and rejection rate $1/1000$, whose system is the verifier given by the equal-probability mixture of the property truth-table tester and coordinate consistency tester, and which satisfies the PCPP conditions for $P$ at that rejection rate.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a property on Boolean strings of length $n$
